description: This Java class defines a service named RespondService which extends IntentService. It handles the ACTION_RESPOND_VIA_MESSAGE intent when the app is the default SMS app, specifically for quick reply functionality.

classes.name: RespondService
classes.description: A service that responds to the ACTION_RESPOND_VIA_MESSAGE intent when the app is the default SMS handler.

methods.name: RespondService
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent IntentService constructor with the TAG name.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Handles the incoming intent, checks if it matches the respond via message action and if the app is the default SMS app before processing.
